issues.on_page: Trimmed PDF skips report p9 (trimmed p4 = report p8, p5 = report p10), p11 (p5 = report p10, p6 = report p12) and p32 (p12 = report p31, p13 = report p33)
issues.issue: Trim gap, not an extraction error. These are probably reconciliations and RSI notes. Every trimmed page (1-15 of 15) is covered and every printed total ties.

issues.on_page: Cash 249,877; Cash held by county treasurers 7,758; Investments 642,749
issues.issue: ending_cash leaves out Cash held by county treasurers 7,758, which the budgetary schedule p12 counts as cash (fund balance 900,384 = 249,877 + 642,749 + 7,758).
The line is printed under the State grants heading. Licenses and permits fits the label, but the statement presents it as a state grant.
Chemigation fees are permit fees, so licenses and permits may fit better. The same applies to detail[6].
Sales tax collected on resale of materials is probably a pass-through collection, not NRD tax revenue, so the sales tax category is questionable. The same applies to detail[47] (3, p13).
This is a mixed line, recorded as state aid with a review note. The GAAP statement p5 shows Federal grant 13,169, which suggests it may be mostly federal.

This is an object line, not a function total: an interfund administrative fee paid to the General Fund, matching GF revenue detail[10] 'Administrative fees' 17,003. Professional/contract services fits better. The same money is recorded as revenue in one fund and spending in the other.

issues.extracted: Transfers 115,000 (in); detail[41] Transfers to sinking funds -163,400
issues.issue: The budgetary-basis transfers in and out don't match and the sinking funds' own schedule isn't printed. Both are correctly recorded as other financing. The GAAP General Fund statement has no transfers, so the sinking funds are inside the General Fund.

issues.on_page: Niobrara River Basin Alliance budget 5,000 and Sales tax budget 4,000 (actual blank)
issues.issue: Budget-only lines with no 2025 actual were left out, so recorded budget_final values fall 9,000 short of the printed budget total 1,257,372. Actual totals are unaffected.

issues.on_page: Schedule of Operating Expenses by Fund (GAAP basis): e.g. Monitoring wells 13,729, Other 68,201, governmental Depreciation 31,608
